snippet.title: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure, a physics-based platformer from Casual Brothers. Tilt the stage and guide a little round chick on a quest to find his missing siblings.

Add Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure to your Steam wishlist!

Explore 120 handcrafted levels across four colourful worlds. Use gravity and momentum to navigate obstacles, uncover hidden routes and bring Marupoyo's family back together.

Choose Family Mode for a more relaxed adventure, or test your skills with the extra speed and challenges of Gamer Mode.

Watch the official trailer and get ready to roll!

Subscribe to Casual Brothers for more Marupoyo gameplay, development updates and release news.

#Marupoyo #Platformer #CasualBrothers
